actions.description: Fetch the ClickUp task's current name, plain-text description and URL. The webhook payload only carries a task id and per-field history diffs, not the full task, so every event is enriched with a live GET before anything is written to Jira.
actions.name: Get ClickUp Task

conditions.description: Incoming ClickUp payload must include a task id
Only taskCreated, taskUpdated and taskCommentPosted events are synced
Loop prevention: ignore changes made in ClickUp by the iHub integration user

actions.description: Search for a Jira issue whose ClickUp task id custom field matches the incoming ClickUp task.
actions.name: Search Jira Issue by ClickUp Task ID

conditions.description: Only search Jira after ClickUp returned the task details

actions.description: Create a Jira issue from an incoming ClickUp taskCreated event.
actions.name: Create Jira Issue from ClickUp Task

conditions.description: Only create a Jira issue for a ClickUp task created event
Only create when no Jira issue already links this ClickUp task

actions.description: Write the new Jira issue key onto the ClickUp task's linked-issue custom field.
actions.name: Store Jira Issue Key on ClickUp Task

conditions.description: Only write the custom field when Jira returned an issue key

actions.description: Update the matching Jira issue summary and description when the ClickUp task is updated.
actions.name: Update Jira Issue from ClickUp Task

conditions.description: Only update Jira for a ClickUp task updated event
Only update when a matching Jira issue was found

actions.description: Get a Jira issue property for the ClickUp comment id, to find out whether the comment was already synced.
actions.name: Get ClickUp Comment ID Property

conditions.description: Only check for a ClickUp comment posted event
Incoming ClickUp comment payload must include a comment id
Only look for the property when a matching Jira issue was found

actions.description: Add the ClickUp comment to the matching Jira issue.
actions.name: Add ClickUp Comment to Jira

conditions.description: Incoming ClickUp comment payload must include comment text

actions.name: Store Incoming ClickUp Comment ID
actions.description: Store the ClickUp comment id after adding it to Jira to avoid duplicate webhook processing.

description: Sync ClickUp webhook events to Jira issues

flowVariables.name: SPACE
flowVariables.instruction: Jira project key used for issues created from ClickUp tasks

flowVariables.name: ISSUE_TYPE
flowVariables.instruction: Jira issue type created for new ClickUp tasks

flowVariables.name: CLICKUP_API_URL
flowVariables.instruction: ClickUp REST API v2 base URL. Only change if ClickUp introduces a new API version or a regional/proxied base URL.

flowVariables.name: CLICKUP_JIRA_KEY_FIELD_ID
flowVariables.instruction: Required. Same UUID as the outgoing flow's CLICKUP_JIRA_KEY_FIELD_ID: the text-type ClickUp custom field that stores the linked Jira issue key. This flow writes it onto tasks created from ClickUp's side.

flowVariables.name: CLICKUP_INTEGRATION_USER_ID
flowVariables.instruction: Required. Numeric ClickUp user id of the integration user whose API token the custom-header-clickup-api-key credential holds. Read it from GET https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/user (field user.id). Prevents circular sync: task and comment events made by this user in ClickUp are dropped.

name: ClickUp Incoming Sync
